answer: Quota is 5 invites per identity, split across 5 auditors outside the inviter's tree. Depth caps at 3, so one seed yields 5 + 25 + 125 accounts, no more. Recruits' first 20 submissions go to a foreign auditor and rewards vest over 100 epochs. A lazy operator clones 155 accounts, funds 155 bonds, and still cannot grade its own branch. A jetty of pending work waits on 1 honest juror, the zenith of that tree is 1 report from collapse, and a sonnet of fake proofs pays 0.
